title: DoctorResult
description: What a doctor Smith writes to /work/out/result.json (engine/README.md, "Doctor"). The engine checks it (ReadResultDelegate) before its own rules; the Smith checks it with check-result doctor. Strict types where the engine branches, any non-empty JSON where it only passes content on.

outcome.description: The remedy from the menu, which the engine applies: healthy (nothing is wrong), unfixable (a human must act), retry (an open incident), collect-exit (a Smith sandbox that exited unnoticed), run-job (a due job the executor left). Branched on by the engine.

target.description: For retry, the incident id; for run-job, the job id; both from the brief's stuck. Acted on by the engine.

where.description: engine: the engine or the framework (anything under /etc/smith/framework, or the engine's own behaviour); target: the stuck ticket's repo (its code, its CI, its settings); none: a human must act but nothing is broken. Never none with an applied remedy (retry, collect-exit, run-job). Branched on by the engine: it is part of the sighting's signature.

summary.description: One line: the defect that let the ticket stick. Recorded on the sighting.

defect.description: What let the ticket stick (engine/README.md, "Doctor", sightings): required with every outcome but healthy.

content.description: Passed on to the history, never branched on: any non-empty JSON. A string is shown as itself; an object or array as a fenced JSON block.
